commands.command:
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
outdir=$base/normalized
umask 022
install -d -m 0755 "$outdir" || exit 1
failed=0
while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r name encoding; do
  [ "$name" = file ] && [ "$encoding" = encoding ] && continue
  [ -n "$name" ] || continue
  case "$name" in */*|.|..) printf 'ERROR unsafe filename: %s\n' "$name"; failed=1; continue;; esac
  src=$base/incoming/$name
  dst=$outdir/$name
  tmp_decoded=$(mktemp "$outdir/.decoded.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  tmp_lf=$(mktemp "$outdir/.normalized.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$tmp_decoded"; exit 1; }
  err=$(mktemp /tmp/text-normalize-error.XXXXXX) || { rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf"; exit 1; }
  if iconv -f "$encoding" -t UTF-8 "$src" >"$tmp_decoded" 2>"$err"; then
    if LC_ALL=C sed 's/\r$//' "$tmp_decoded" >"$tmp_lf"; then
      chmod 0644 "$tmp_lf"
      mv -f "$tmp_lf" "$dst"
      rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$err"
      printf 'PUBLISHED %s (%s to UTF-8, LF)\n' "$name" "$encoding"
    else
      printf 'ERROR newline normalization failed for %s\n' "$name"
      rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf" "$err"
      failed=1
    fi
  else
    detail=$(tr '\n' ' ' <"$err")
    printf 'UNDECODABLE %s declared=%s: %s\n' "$name" "$encoding" "$detail"
    rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf" "$err"
    failed=1
  fi
done <"$base/encodings.tsv"
printf 'conversion_status=%s\n' "$failed"
exit "$failed"

  if [ -n "$extra" ]; then printf 'ERROR malformed mapping for %s\n' "$name"; failed=1; continue; fi
  case "$name" in */*|.|..) printf 'ERROR unsafe filename: %s\n' "$name"; failed=1; continue;; esac
  src=$base/incoming/$name
  dst=$outdir/$name
  tmp_decoded=$(mktemp "$outdir/.decoded.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  tmp_lf=$(mktemp "$outdir/.normalized.XXXXXX") || { rm -f "$tmp_decoded"; exit 1; }
  err=$(mktemp /tmp/text-normalize-error.XXXXXX) || { rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf"; exit 1; }
  if iconv -f "$encoding" -t UTF-8 "$src" >"$tmp_decoded" 2>"$err"; then
    if LC_ALL=C sed 's/\r$//' "$tmp_decoded" >"$tmp_lf"; then
      chmod 0644 "$tmp_lf"
      mv -f "$tmp_lf" "$dst"
      rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$err"
      printf 'PUBLISHED %s (%s to UTF-8, LF)\n' "$name" "$encoding"
    else
      printf 'ERROR newline normalization failed for %s\n' "$name"
      rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf" "$err"
      failed=1
    fi
  else
    detail=$(tr '\n' ' ' <"$err")
    printf 'UNDECODABLE %s declared=%s: %s\n' "$name" "$encoding" "$detail"
    rm -f "$tmp_decoded" "$tmp_lf" "$err"
    failed=1

done <"$base/encodings.tsv"
